content.summary: Review of Claude Agent SDK V2 Integration (5 work items): PASS

claude-agent-sdk-tool-bridge.summary: Tool bridge correctly implements in-process MCP server, filtering native tools and exposing OpenCode tools. Permissions validation is correctly integrated.

claude-v2-llm-routing.summary: Routing logic in LLM.stream correctly identifies claude-agent-sdk provider and routes to native path. Session ID passing and fallback to existing path works as intended.

claude-v2-native-stream.summary: Native streaming uses V2 SDK create/resume session patterns. Event mapping from SDK events to OpenCode stream events is comprehensive.

claude-v2-session-management.summary: Session persistence is implemented using Storage with model invalidation. SDK session IDs are correctly tracked and used for resumption.

claude-v2-tool-execution.summary: Tool execution is handled via the MCP bridge (superior to manual loop). Multi-tool support and error handling are verified in tests.

findings.suggestion: Implementation uses MCP bridge for tool execution instead of manual session.send() loop, which is more robust and cleaner.

suggestions.suggestion: Keep DISABLED_SDK_TOOLS in tool-bridge.ts monitored as SDK updates might add new conflicting tools.
